text: New World seed box: ctrl+a then Delete/BackSpace does not select-all; only one char removed per backspace, so replacing the prefilled 'Ironvale' with the Share-screen number takes many backspaces (may be low-fps modifier timing)
Load list rows show only 'Day N - <nation>' and a timestamp, no seed/world name; two worlds from the same seed (one barely started, auto-saved by Main Menu at tick 125) are hard to tell apart
